proposals.before: In the fourth year, on bingchen day in the first month of spring, he hunted tigers on Eastern Mountain.
proposals.after: In the fourth year, on bingshen day in the first month of spring, he hunted tigers on Eastern Mountain.
proposals.reason: Chinese 丙申 is bingshen, not bingchen (丙辰).

proposals.before: In the intercalary sixth month, on dingmao day, his younger brother Su was made tixin, and Kang Moj was made yilijin bil.
proposals.after: In the intercalary sixth month, on dingmao day, his younger brother Su was made tixin, and Kang Moji was made yilibi.
proposals.reason: 夷離畢 is the office yilibi, not 'yilijin bil'; 康默記 is Kang Moji.

proposals.before: Cun pressed toward Wangdu and met five thousand of our horsemen, gaunt with hunger; he surrounded them and fought four fierce engagements but could not break the encirclement.
proposals.after: Cun pressed toward Wangdu and met five thousand of our horsemen under Tunei; he surrounded them and fought four fierce engagements but could not break the encirclement.
proposals.reason: 禿餒 is the personal name Tunei (a Khitan commander), not the phrase 'gaunt with hunger'.

proposals.before: Cun marched toward Wangdu, encountered five thousand of our cavalry weakened by hunger, surrounded them, fought fiercely four times, but could not break free.
proposals.after: Cun marched toward Wangdu, encountered five thousand of our cavalry under Tunei, surrounded them, fought fiercely four times, but could not break free.
proposals.reason: 禿餒 is the personal name Tunei, not 'weakened by hunger'.

proposals.before: In the second month, on bingyin day, Great Marshal Yaogu harried the Xi.
proposals.after: In the second month, on bingyin day, Great Marshal Yaogu harried the Xiang.
proposals.reason: Chinese 略項 refers to the Xiang (Dangxiang) tribes, not the Xi (奚).

proposals.before: In the second month, on bingyin day, Great Marshal Yaogu raided the Xi.
proposals.after: In the second month, on bingyin day, Great Marshal Yaogu raided the Xiang.
proposals.reason: Chinese 略項 refers to Xiang/Dangxiang, not Xi.

proposals.before: The Xi chieftain Boru'en, Wang Yu, and the allies who had marched with him from Uighur, Silla, Tibetan, Xi, Shiwei, Shatuo, and Wugu lands were singled out for lavish reward.
proposals.after: The Xi chieftain Boru'en, Wang Yu, and the allies who had marched with him from Uighur, Silla, Tibetan, Xiang, Shiwei, Shatuo, and Wugu lands were singled out for lavish reward.
proposals.reason: In the list 回鶻、新羅、吐蕃、項、室韋、沙陀、烏古, 項 is Xiang/Dangxiang, not Xi (already used for 奚部長).

proposals.before: In the rebellions of Gege and Anduan, Taizu spared them and then put them back in office—was that truly the measure of a prince?
proposals.after: In the rebellions of Lage and Anduan, Taizu spared them and then put them back in office—was that truly the measure of a prince?
proposals.reason: 剌葛 is Lage (also written Lage/La Ge), not Gege.

decisions.reason: Chinese 丙申 is the bingshen day; idiomatic “bingchen” would require 丙辰, so the replacement restores the correct sexagenary name.
The same 丙申 is misread as bingchen in the literal field; bingshen matches the Chinese stem-branch pair without other changes.
康默記 is Kang Moji and 夷離畢 is the office yilibi; “Kang Moj” and “yilijin bil” are naming/office errors, and the proposed wording corrects both.

decisions.after: Cun pressed toward Wangdu and met five thousand of our horsemen under Tunei, who surrounded him; he fought four fierce engagements but could not break the encirclement.
decisions.reason: 禿餒 is the commander Tunei, not “gaunt with hunger,” but 圍之 with 存乃得出 in the next unit shows our cavalry surrounded Cun, not the reverse; the proposal still inverts agent and patient.

decisions.after: Cun marched toward Wangdu, encountered five thousand of our cavalry under Tunei, who surrounded him; he fought fiercely four times but could not break free.
decisions.reason: 禿餒 is again the name Tunei, not hunger, yet “surrounded them” keeps the wrong encircling agent; revise so Tunei’s force surrounds Cun, matching 圍之 and his later escape.
